question: Which products were picked for order 421, and what is the average number of units picked for each product, using FIFO (First-In, First-Out) method?
sql:
-- Verify FIFO consumption for order 421
-- For each product, simulate FIFO from inventory and compare with picking_line
WITH order_qty AS (
    SELECT product_id, SUM(qty) AS total_needed
    FROM orderlines
    WHERE order_id = 421
    GROUP BY product_id
),
fifo_consumption AS (
    SELECT i.product_id, i.purchase_id, p.purchased, i.location_id, i.qty AS available_qty,
           SUM(i.qty) OVER (PARTITION BY i.product_id ORDER BY p.purchased, i.id) AS cumulative_available
    FROM inventory i
    JOIN purchases p ON i.purchase_id = p.id
    WHERE i.product_id IN (SELECT product_id FROM order_qty)
),
-- For each product, determine which batches are consumed under FIFO
order_421_picking AS (
    SELECT pl.product_id, pl.qty, pl.location_id, pl.line_no
    FROM picking_line pl
    WHERE pl.order_id = 421
)
SELECT oq.product_id, p.name, 
       oq.total_needed,
       COUNT(op.line_no) AS num_picks,
       ROUND(AVG(op.qty), 2) AS avg_units_picked,
       SUM(op.qty) AS total_picked
FROM order_qty oq
JOIN products p ON oq.product_id = p.id
JOIN order_421_picking op ON oq.product_id = op.product_id
GROUP BY oq.product_id, p.name, oq.total_needed
ORDER BY oq.product_id
